Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: combined SOC2/ISO/SIG questionnaire (initial package request)

Logan,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is CrestBank's combined assurance questionnaire — we consolidated SOC2, ISO 27001 and SIG items into a single workbook to speed review. Can you confirm:

- Whether Redwood can provide a single control mapping showing which controls satisfy multiple standards (SOC2->SIG->ISO)
- High-level SOC2 attestation (summary) and whether we can get a copy of the latest SOC2 report under NDA
- Artifacts we can expect within 5 business days vs. items that need additional redaction/coordination (pen tests, key‑rotation logs)

We need the initial packet by EOD Apr 27 to keep the procurement timeline. If there are gaps we can accept interim evidence and a delivery plan.

I've copied procurement (rfp@crestbank.com) for the secure upload details. Questionnaire attached: crestbank_questionnaire_v1.pdf

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Vendor Risk
CrestBank
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: combined SOC2/ISO/SIG questionnaire (initial package request)

Hi Marta — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. We can absolutely provide a consolidated control mapping and an initial evidence packet by EOD Apr 27. Quick plan:

1) Security will produce a SOC2 summary and a draft control crosswalk that maps SOC2 reports, ISO controls and SIG rows -> expected Apr 23.
2) We'll upload the following by Apr 27: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf, sig_control_map_draft.xlsx, and our standard KMS rotation policy excerpt.
3) Pen testing artifacts and any raw logs that require redaction will be provided under a follow-up schedule (target Apr 30).

Laura / Neha / Karthik — can you confirm you have capacity to own artifacts and the secure upload? Also flag any items that need legal NDA before the SOC2 report is shared.

Marta — would a 30-minute kickoff call tomorrow at 10:00am PT work to walk the crosswalk and prioritize items? If not, suggest alternate times.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: combined SOC2/ISO/SIG questionnaire (technical clarifications)

All — reviewing the questionnaire, a few technical clarifications that will determine which artifacts we pull/provide: 

- For SIG Data Protection items: CrestBank wants confirmation on envelope encryption vs. application-level encryption. We can supply a configuration excerpt showing TLS termination and application-level AES‑GCM usage, but any customer-specific envelope keys are not included.
- Log retention: are you evaluating for 12 months or 24 months? We have 13-month default retention for production token logs; extended retention requires a billing contract amendment or dedicated retention buckets.
- KMS: we rotate CMKs annually, and have rotation events in CloudKMS. We can provide redacted rotation logs (month-level) and our rotation policy document (kms-key-rotation-policy.pdf).

I've attached a draft control map (sig_control_map_draft.xlsx) with my initial mapping for the 'Data Security' and 'Infrastructure' rows. I'll add sample config snippets for the encryption item once you confirm the envelope key question.

-Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@crestbank.com>, CrestBank RFP <rfp@crestbank.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: combined SOC2/ISO/SIG questionnaire (initial artifacts)

Marta / procurement team — attaching the items we can share now under our standard NDA (I've redacted any tenant identifiers and customer-specific metadata where required):

- redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (summary of scope and unredacted report available after NDA)
- sig_control_map_draft.xlsx (working crosswalk: SOC2 -> SIG -> ISO rows)
- kms-key-rotation-policy.pdf (policy excerpt + rotation cadence)
- pentest-summary-2026.pdf (executive findings; detailed vuln lists are shared under additional controls)

Secure upload: please use the secure folder at https://secure-upload.redwood.com/crestbank/req-5821. We will also make the SOC2 report available via DocuSign protected link once procurement confirms standard vendor NDA.

Notes:
- Pen test raw evidence and network diagrams will be staged for redaction review on Apr 30.
- For log retention beyond 13 months, we need a short SOW to provision archival buckets.

If you want a brief walkthrough of the crosswalk, Karthik and I can join the call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: RFP: combined SOC2/ISO/SIG questionnaire (follow-up)

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the secure upload link. I downloaded the SOC2 summary and the draft crosswalk. A couple of outstanding asks from our side before procurement will clear initial scoring:

1) Evidence of annual key rotation events with timestamps and the owner for the most recent rotation (we need proof of process + an instance).
2) Confirmation of scope for external penetration tests (is infrastructure + application included?) and a copy of the engagement letter or scope statement for the 2026 test.

If you can estimate when the rotation logs and the pen‑test scope doc can be staged, that will determine whether we can meet our APR 30 internal scoring. Also, please advise if you require an NDA before we accept the SOC2 report via DocuSign.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Vendor Risk
CrestBank

Marta / Team — quick status update and delivery plan:

- Pen test scope and engagement letter: we will place the engagement scope and executive pentest-summary-2026.pdf in the folder by Apr 30; full findings require approval from our legal team for redaction and will follow the redaction workflow (expected May 4).
- Log retention: default 13 months; for CrestBank we can propose archival retention to 24 months via an addendum — sample SOW attached in the upload area.

Next steps: 
1) We will upload the two pending items to https://secure-upload.redwood.com/crestbank/req-5821 on Apr 30.
2) If CrestBank requires the full SOC2 report, please confirm NDA acceptance and we'll issue a DocuSign link.
3) Karthik and I are available for a 30-minute call on Apr 29 10:00am PT to walk the SIG crosswalk and any open technical items.

Attachments to be uploaded on Apr 30: kms-key-rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-logs-2026-redacted.csv, pentest-summary-2026.pdf, sig_control_map_draft.xlsx (finalized).

Thanks — we want to make sure your procurement window isn't delayed.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
